title: Standing-Part Rule for Waivers of Pre-K Tuition Late Fees
content:
**Rule.** Under the standing-part rule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a waiver of a Pre-K tuition late fee is never more than the part of the late fee still standing. The credits counted are every credit already posted against that late fee, whatever its credit reason.

| Credits already standing against the late fee | The waiver acts on |
|---|---|
| some, leaving part of the late fee | that remaining part |
| enough to cover the whole late fee | nothing |
| none | the whole late fee |

## Worked cases (hypothetical late fee of 36.00)

| Credits already against the late fee | Part still standing | Most the waiver can be |
|---|---|---|
| 24.00 | 12.00 | 12.00 |
| 36.00 | none | nothing |
| 40.00 | none | nothing |
| none | 36.00 | 36.00 |
